changelog: Your collection: track every card you own by printing, finish and condition, with prices and value history, overlapping collections and a wishlist of what your decks need.
The phone app: an Android companion that scans cards, holds its own card index and builds decks with no PC, and pairs with this computer over your Wi-Fi (Tailscale optional).
The Build tab is laid out like MTG Arena: cards across the top, filters in the middle, your deck stacked by mana value along the bottom.
Card art everywhere: hover a card name to see the card, with thumbnails in lists. Official rulings in the card view, and a Buy on TCGplayer link.
Combo data downloads as one file: all ~111,000 Commander Spellbook combos in about a minute.
Fixed: double-clicking densa-deck.exe from the ZIP now opens the app; saving a new version no longer renames the deck; free users can save from Analyze (3 decks).
Settings -> App updates: switch this update check off, or check now. Nothing ever installs itself.
